description: Outlook desktop inline forward of the plain Week 12 letter. The minimal-structure holdout: no multipart/related layer, no inline image, ASCII subject. Also a two-hop chain, where the immediately quoted sender is not the missionary.
outerSubject: FW: Week 12 — transfers and a bike repair

original.subject: Week 12 — transfers and a bike repair

notes: original.from is the intermediate forwarder, not the missionary: the letter reached this mailbox already forwarded once, so the first quoted header block attributes it to family.example@gmail.com. Taking the nearest quoted sender as the author would credit the wrong person, and the missionary's attribution sits deeper in the quoted text.
Every other fixture carries a multipart/related layer, an inline cid image, and a non-ASCII subject. This one has none of them, so code that assumes any of the three still has to pass here.
The two attachments appear in reverse order relative to the other captures; attachment order is not stable and must not be asserted.
